name: STAR Assurance — GMST implementation cross-audit
summary: Cross-audit of GMST implementations (ERFA gmst82/gmst06, astropy, skyfield, python-sgp4, pyorbital, star_sidereal) validated on Vallado Example 3-5; wrap-safe envelopes 1950-2050 separating IAU 1982 and IAU 2006 families.
reference: Vallado, Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and Applications, Example 3-5 (GMST 152.578787810 deg at 1992-08-20 12:14 UT1)
reference_observed: IAU 1982 implementations reproduce Vallado to 1e-5 arcsec, IAU 2006 ones to 0.035 arcsec (model difference); synthetic: 0.09 arcsec valid, 0.11 excluded, 0.05 arcsec post-2000 offset measured, 359.9999 vs 0.0001 deg = 0.72 arcsec

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees in, arcsec differences; JD on the UT1 scale (TT = UT1 + 69.184 s where a model needs TT)
review.G-06: published constants cited in source; drivers use documented APIs only
review.G-08: subprocess only for the audited implementation; epochs via stdin; runner names prefixed
review.G-13: failed run raises with stderr tail; refusing or unvalidated implementations excluded from comparisons
